claims.sentence: NICE has updated four technology appraisals on type 2 diabetes medicines to match its type 2 diabetes guideline, and withdrawn four on dapagliflozin.
claims.note: Two NICE-restricted searches (pass 1 and author re-check): four TAs updated, four dapagliflozin TAs withdrawn.

claims.sentence: On 15 September 2026 NICE published a news story on updating four technology appraisals for type 2 diabetes.
claims.note: Re-check search: news item dated 15 September 2026.

claims.sentence: The updated appraisals were brought into line with NICE's guideline on type 2 diabetes in adults.
NICE describes the exercise as the first test of a new way of keeping all of its guidance aligned.
NICE has updated four technology appraisals for type 2 diabetes medicines so that they match the recommendations in its guideline on type 2 diabetes in adults.
NICE says the pilot shows that appraisals can be kept aligned with guidelines more efficiently, without compromising the rigour or transparency of its decisions.
NICE also withdrew four appraisals on dapagliflozin: TA288, TA390, TA418 and TA583.
It treats the withdrawal as a routing decision, and says it is not subject to appeal.
